name: planmap-vscode
description: See what you approved and what your code actually does, as one map.

planmap.cliPath.description: Path to the PlanMap CLI entry file. Leave empty to use the CLI in this repository (../src/cli/cli.js).

planmap.nodePath.description: Node executable used to run the CLI. Leave empty to use VS Code's bundled runtime.

planmap.llmEndpoint.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible endpoint used to group code into features and draft plans. Leave empty for a local model with [Ollama](https://ollama.com) at `http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions`, which needs no API key. For OpenRouter: `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions`, with **PlanMap: Set OpenRouter API Key**.

planmap.llmModel.markdownDescription: Model name for the endpoint above. Leave empty for `qwen2.5-coder:7b`, PlanMap's local default (`ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:7b`).

planmap.llmBatchSize.markdownDescription: Declarations classified per request. Leave 0 for PlanMap's default of 30. A local model with a small context window does better at 10.

scripts.test: tsc -p . && for t in test/*.mjs; do node "$t" || exit 1; done
